exposure: Women who were febrile or hypothermic during delivery stay
Women who attended at least 4 ANC visits
Attendance at at least 4 antenatal care (ANC) visits
cohort: 1,541 women immediately postpartum at Mbarara Regional Referral Hospital (MRRH)
finding: Neither ANC attendance, abnormal temperature after delivery, nor their interaction, were significantly associated with post-discharge PNC.
mod_finding: Of those who reported at least one PNC visit, 59/86 (68.6%) delivered by cesarean.
